title: Operator Workflow Trace Tool Surfacing Result
claim: FP-MCP-266 operator workflow trace tools surfaced after MCP reload and executed through ChatGPT MCP: the V1 writer wrote trace artifacts and the read-only summarizer summarized them.
summary: After reload, api_tool discovery found forgepilot_record_operator_workflow_trace and forgepilot_summarize_operator_workflow_traces. The summarizer executed successfully. The writer then recorded an OPERATOR_WORKFLOW_TRACE_V1 post-reload trace, and the summarizer read it with deviationCounts NONE: 1. During follow-up cleanup, one additional read-only tool-selection mismatch and one checkpoint-admission mismatch were recorded as V1 traces, including a correction trace. All trace artifacts were committed before this checkpoint.
caveats: The post-reload surfacing result is now proven, but the workflow trace log also records that tool-selection mismatches can still occur in the operator control plane.
Earlier manual V0 OPERATOR traces are readable by the summarizer but appear with UNKNOWN deviation fields because they predate OPERATOR_WORKFLOW_TRACE_V1.
This checkpoint does not run any live OpenCode lifecycle action.
boundaries: No OpenCode HTTP session was created.
No ForgePilot runner start endpoint was contacted.
No secrets or .env files were read.
